systems.platform: integrated into DHIS2; smartphone data collection form
systems.owner: Ministry of Health (INSP and the Direction Générale de la Santé et de l'Hygiène Publique) with Vital Strategies
systems.tiers: community health worker sites in the health districts of Diéma, Kita, Sikasso and Kignan; the electronic form is said to be set up for all community health worker sites

note: Community health workers notify live births and perinatal deaths by smartphone into the health system (729 live births and 35 perinatal deaths in eight months, 43.8% of notified births in the four districts' health zones); a health-side notification tool, with no statement that a civil status centre makes a digital record. The abstract gives no dates for the eight months.
